steps.name: ＋ 추가 → 삽입 패널의 도형 타일 25칸
steps.js: document.querySelector('#addBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('#menu .tile[data-ins^="shape:"]').length; return n===25 ? true : 'tiles='+n

steps.name: 별 타일 → shape 요소 26개·속성 도형 종류
steps.js: document.querySelector('#menu .tile[data-ins="shape:star5"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el[data-type="shape"]').length; const s=document.querySelector('select[data-k="shape"]'); return n===26 && s && s.value==='star5' ? true : 'n='+n+' sel='+(s&&s.value)

steps.name: 속성 도형 종류 → 정육면체(면 3)
steps.js: const s=document.querySelector('select[data-k="shape"]'); s.value='cube'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el[data-type="shape"]')].pop(); return el.querySelectorAll('.rs-shp').length===3 ? true : 'faces='+el.querySelectorAll('.rs-shp').length

steps.name: 다이어그램 타일 → 순환(요소 8개)
steps.js: document.querySelector('#addBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const n0=document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el').length; document.querySelector('#menu .tile[data-ins="diagram:cycle"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const d=document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el').length-n0; return d===8 ? true : 'added='+d

steps.name: 프로세스(갈매기) → shape 4개
steps.js: document.querySelector('#addBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const n0=document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el[data-type="shape"]').length; document.querySelector('#menu .tile[data-ins="diagram:process"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const d=document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el[data-type="shape"]').length-n0; return d===4 ? true : 'added='+d

steps.name: 차트 타일 → chart 요소 · 아이콘 타일 → icon 요소
steps.js: document.querySelector('#addBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); document.querySelector('#menu .tile[data-ins="chart:column"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); document.querySelector('#addBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); document.querySelector('#menu .tile[data-ins="icon:check"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const c=document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el[data-type="chart"] svg').length, i=document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el[data-type="icon"] svg').length; return c===1 && i===1 ? true : 'chart='+c+' icon='+i

steps.name: 실행 취소 6번(별·정육면체·순환·프로세스·차트·아이콘) → 원래 25개
steps.js: for (let i=0;i<6;i++) { document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('#host .rs-el').length; return n===25 ? true : 'n='+n
